metadata.description:
You can now listen to 13 stories from the best-selling Ten Little series in one card.


Includes:
Ten Little Pirates 
Ten Little Princesses 
Ten Little Dinosaurs 
Ten Little Monsters 
Ten Little Elves 
Ten Little Superheroes 
Ten Little Robots 
Ten Little Aliens 
Ten Little Monkeys 
Ten Little Unicorns 
Ten Little Penguins
Ten Little Bugs 
Ten Little Pumpkins

Part traditional counting rhymes, part fun-filled stories, the Ten Little series is perfect for sharing and has sold over 2.5 million copies worldwide.
